Docusign Envelope ID: D6255081-1CE8-4C28-A35F-245CC691EFBD

  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JANUARY 6, 2026

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Torosis at 5:30 p.m., on
  Tuesday, January 6, 2026, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Caroline Torosis
  Councilmember Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya

  Absent:  Mayor Pro Tem Jesse Zwick

  Also Present:  City Manager Oliver Chi
  Interim City Attorney Heidi von Tongeln
  Assistant City Clerk Maria Dacanay-Wisner

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:30 p.m., with Mayor
  Pro Tem Zwick absent. Councilmember Zernitskaya led the assemblage in
  the Pledge of Allegiance.

  STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
  ACCOUNTABILITY  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Councilmember Negrete.
  (LAND
  ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)

  LEVINE ACT  No Councilmembers made disclosures regarding the Levine Act (Govt Code
  DISCLOSURE  Section 84308).

  PUBLIC INPUT FOR  No members of the public commented on the Closed Session item.
  CLOSED SESSION ONLY:

  CLOSED SESSIONS  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 5:32 p.m., to consider
  Closed Sessions and returned at 7:15 p.m., with Mayor Pro Tem Zwick
  absent, to report the following:

  5.A. Consider appointment of unrepresented employee – Gov. Code §
  54957(b); City negotiator: Mayor/City Manager; Unrepresented
  employee: City Clerk/Interim City Clerk; conference with labor
  negotiator - Gov. Code § 54957.6; City negotiator: Mayor/City
  Manager; Unrepresented employee: City Clerk/Interim City Clerk

  1  January 6, 2026
 Docusign Envelope ID: D6255081-1CE8-4C28-A35F-245CC691EFBD

  The City Attorney advised this matter was heard, a candidate was selected
  and the City Manager will extend an offer.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 7:16 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Maria Dacanay-Wisner  Caroline Torosis
  Assistant City Clerk  Mayor

  2  January 6, 2026
